answer.note:
I did not use the incoming A/B pair. All four ref files contain the same generic text and give no file-specific priority, so I chose from the code.

Primary target is D, dogwhistle/honest.py. `_verify_history` (lines 175-195) matches the request:
- It rejects `prereg_commit == ledger_commit` ("ledger seal must be a separate commit").
- It requires `git diff --name-only` between the two commits to equal exactly the public seal file.
- It also checks that the preregistered source is unchanged and that the committed digest matches.

Second is C, dogwhistle/visibility.py. It has a near-identical `_verify_history` (lines 191-205) with no equal-commit rejection and no changed-files check, so it is a sibling to rule out.

A (study.py) and B (heldout.py) have three-commit `verify_history` variants (prereg, seal, ledger). They are not the two-arm verifier with the checks the request describes.

Suggested 60-minute split:
- D: 35 min
- C: 15 min
- B: 5 min
- A: 5 min

I only read the history-verifier functions in honest.py and visibility.py. I did not run any tests.
